activities.name: Plant a Money Tree
activities.blurb: Plant a deposit, choose the rate, compounding and monthly additions, then fast-forward the years and watch the tree grow. Hit the target size!
activities.entryBlurb: Plant money and watch your tree grow bigger every year!

activities.name: Future You Simulator
activities.blurb: Plan saving from age 16 to 65 for three people. Compare starting early vs late, employer matches, and Roth vs. traditional, then answer the planner's questions.
activities.entryBlurb: Two friends save money. One starts early, one starts late. Who has more when they're old?

activities.name: Insurance Year
activities.blurb: Pick a health, car and home plan (premium vs. deductible), then live through 12 months of random events. Was it worth it?
activities.entryBlurb: Pick protection, then see what happens in a year full of surprises!

activities.name: Rainy Day Challenge
activities.blurb: Decide how much of each paycheck goes to your emergency fund, then face a year of surprises. Avoid high-interest debt!
activities.entryBlurb: Fill your rainy-day jar, then see if it's ready for surprises!

activities.name: Compare Loan Offers
activities.blurb: Three lenders, three offers. Compute monthly payments and total cost with fees, find the best deal, and see what extra payments do.
activities.entryBlurb: Which loan costs less in the end?

activities.name: Real or Red Flag?
activities.blurb: Sort charity signs: legit, or a red flag?

activities.name: Long-Term Quiz
activities.blurb: Saving, compounding, retirement, insurance and giving.
